## suggestMigrations() function

Suggest new migrations that would improve graph quality.

This function analyzes the graph to identify opportunities for new migrations that would: - Bridge disconnected version components - Eliminate lossy paths by providing direct, lossless alternatives - Shorten long migration paths with more direct routes

The suggestions are prioritized by impact, with bridging disconnected components being the most critical.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function suggestMigrations(graph: MigrationGraph): MigrationSuggestion[];
```

## Example


```typescript
const suggestions = suggestMigrations(graph);

for (const suggestion of suggestions) {
  console.log(`Suggest migration: ${suggestion.from} -> ${suggestion.to}`);
  console.log(`Reason: ${suggestion.reason}`);
  console.log(`Current path length: ${suggestion.currentPathLength}`);

  if (suggestion.currentLoss) {
    console.log(`Would preserve: ${suggestion.currentLoss.join(', ')}`);
  }
}
```
